description: #454: a scheduled check that finds nothing new ends with the single line `.` and nothing else, though the Resume block holds a standing waiting-on entry. The same entry is given when Robin asks for it and when Robin speaks to the coordinator.

graders.name: a quiet scheduled check replies with nothing, or exactly `.`
graders.rule: A check that finds nothing ends with the single line `.` and nothing else.

graders.name: asked, the standing waiting-on entry is given
graders.rule: The standing waiting-on list stays in the Resume block and on the board; give it only when the user addresses you or asks, or when an entry on it changes.
